criteria.description: GET /products with a category filter must return total equal to the count of products matching that category, not the full catalogue count.
criteria.evidence: Inline vitest test 'Req1: category=electronics total===4' ran against the real SQLite test DB and passed: GET /products?category=electronics&limit=10 returned status 200 and res.body.total === 4. productService.ts:38-40 adds 'LOWER(category) = LOWER(?)' to conditions[], which is used in the COUNT(*) query at line 58-60, so total is filtered. Test result: ✓ src/tests/visible/verify_totals.test.ts > Requirement verification > Req1: category=electronics total===4.

criteria.description: GET /products with an inStock filter must return total equal to the count of products matching the stock status.
criteria.evidence: Inline vitest test 'Req2: inStock=true limit=6 total===11 totalPages===2' passed: GET /products?inStock=true&limit=6 returned status 200, res.body.total === 11, res.body.totalPages === 2. productService.ts:42-44 adds 'in_stock = ?' to conditions[], applied to both COUNT(*) and SELECT. Pagination test 'returns totalPages: 2 for 15 products with limit 10' passed confirming unfiltered total === 15. Test result: ✓ verify_totals > Req2.

criteria.description: GET /products with a search filter must return total equal to the count of products whose name matches the search term.
criteria.evidence: Inline vitest test 'Req3: search=laptop total matches only laptop products (not 15)' passed: GET /products?search=laptop&limit=50 returned status 200, res.body.total === res.body.data.length AND res.body.total < 15. productService.ts:34-37 adds 'LOWER(name) LIKE ?' to conditions[], applied to both COUNT(*) and SELECT. Test result: ✓ verify_totals > Req3.

criteria.description: The featured filter must be applied as a SQL WHERE featured = ? condition before pagination; post-pagination JS filter block must be removed from productService.ts.
criteria.evidence: Inline vitest test 'Req4: featured=true limit=3 returns 3 featured items, total = featured product count' passed: GET /products?featured=true&limit=3 returned 3 items all with featured===true, and total matched the count from GET /products?featured=true&limit=50. productService.ts:46-49 shows conditions.push('featured = ?') applied before the COUNT(*) and SELECT queries. Full file inspection of productService.ts (109 lines) confirms NO post-pagination JS filter block exists — line 66 reads 'const data = rows.map(rowToProduct)' with no subsequent .filter() call for featured. Test result: ✓ verify_totals > Req4.

criteria.description: totalPages must be computed as Math.ceil(total / limit) so that a non-zero remainder always adds one full page.
criteria.evidence: productService.ts:73 reads 'totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit)'. Test 'Pagination — totalPages boundary > returns totalPages: 2 for 15 products with limit 10' passed (15/10=1.5 → ceil → 2). pnpm test verbose: ✓ src/tests/visible/pagination.test.ts > Pagination — totalPages boundary > returns totalPages: 2 for 15 products with limit 10. Inline test also confirmed inStock=true limit=6 returns totalPages: 2 (11/6=1.833 → ceil → 2).

criteria.description: Exact-division pagination must remain correct: when total is evenly divisible by limit, totalPages equals the quotient with no extra page.
criteria.evidence: Test 'Pagination — totalPages boundary > returns totalPages: 3 for 15 products with limit 5' passed (15/5=3.0 → ceil → 3, no extra page). pnpm test verbose: ✓ src/tests/visible/pagination.test.ts > Pagination — totalPages boundary > returns totalPages: 3 for 15 products with limit 5. Test Files: 2 passed, Tests: 21 passed, 0 failing.
